payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all nine 2×2 subgrids, counts black cells, checks if count in {0,1,3,4}. Early exit on success; otherwise NO.
payload.rationale: Iterates over all nine 2x2 squares, counts black cells, checks if count in {0,1,3,4}. Early exit on success. Not recursive, but early exit mimics pruning; thus branch-and-bound subtype among options.
